summary.text: Albert Hunter is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Republican incumbent Angelia Orr.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Hunter listed three key campaign messages: adequate funding for public education and school safety, protection of surface and ground water and other environmental stewardship, and accessible health care and support for local businesses and for fire and police departments.
Hunter named civil rights as a policy area of personal interest.
